method: One stone phrase set per stone and one outcome phrase set per item, fixed before any count was requested. The phrase writer saw only each stone's name and date and each outcome's text: no ratings, scores, sources, eligibility or control labels. Phrases are searched as exact quoted phrases, joined by OR within a set; a pair query joins the stone set and the outcome set with AND.
